messages:
kevin: Quick sync — I pushed a prototype of a "billing waterfall" panel to the cost dashboard branch. It's focused on per-model amortized cost + how shared cache savings get split across routes. Link: https://git/repo/branches/billing-waterfall :eyes:
maria: Nice. Can you show how you split shared cache? last time we debated slab vs proportional split it got messy for bursty tenants
kevin: Prototype uses proportional by token-contribution, but there's an option in the query to switch to 'sticky' (route-first) allocation. API param: `cache_split=proportional|sticky|cohort`
liz: How does that behave with routing fallbacks? if a route falls back to a cheaper model mid-request, do we reassign savings?
kevin: Good catch. Right now the panel shows pre-routing allocation (where cache hit actually occurred) and a second line for post-routing reconciliation. We log both lines and show a delta row in the waterfall
sam: Can we avoid recalculating for every invoc? sounds expensive. Maybe sample and extrapolate?
maria: sampling is fine if the UI clearly shows sample rate and CI. We already do sample metadata in other panels. Maybe add a small badge: `sample 10% ±2%`
kevin: Implemented sample knob in the prototype: `sample_rate=0.1`. By default we render full-precision for routes with >10k tokens/day, sample others
infra-bot: deploy-dag: canary deploy of branch billing-waterfall to staging at 2026-03-21T14:02Z succeeded :white_check_mark:
liz: UX ask — make the waterfall rows collapsible by model family. Large customers want to toggle into 'per-sku' view vs 'per-route' view
kevin: Yep there are two toggles: Group by = [route | sku | tenant]. Also added an 'expose lineage' checkbox that shows which batch/prefetch produced the cache hit
sam: For lineage, can we show a cheap sparkline of hotkeys and a tiny sample of prompt prefixes? won't need full KV data, just counts
kevin: Exactly, the lineage view uses fingerprints and counts only. No raw prompt payloads. Privacy-safe
maria: How does quota enforcement tie in? customers want to see how quota throttles affected unit-econ over time (e.g., throttled requests pushed to lower-cost models)
kevin: We emit a 'quota-impact' overlay. It marks timeseries segments where throttles or quota-denied events caused routing fallback. On hover we show affected tokens and cost delta
liz: Are we surfacing amortization of reserved Dedicated capacity? that should alter per-token cost for high-volume tenants
kevin: There's a 'capacity mix' input in the panel; you can toggle between Hosted-only pricing and blended (hosted + reserved) to see unit-cost changes. We pull commitment coverage from billing metadata
sam: One internal API thought — can we standardize on a single per-invocation econ record so dashboard + alerts + billing use same source? Right now tracing and billing diverge
maria: +1 on a canonical econ record. Hard requirement for accurate rollouts
kevin: I prototyped `econ_record.v1` with fields: `invocation_id, route_id, model_sku, token_counts, cache_hit_flags, routing_path, cost_components`. It's a small JSON line emitted to econ kafka topic
liz: Any privacy/compliance issues with routing_path? sometimes it encodes customer-defined route names
kevin: We hash route names for the public UI and keep mapping in internal-only store for support. UI sees friendly labels only if user has permission
infra-bot: job-econ-ingest: consumer lag at 3 partitions. auto-restart scheduled in 2m
devex: UX question — can we add a 'what-if' slider that simulates increasing prefetch/prefix-caching aggressiveness and shows projected cost + QPS change? PMs love interactive knobs
kevin: There is a simulation mode: stickiness slider + prefetch multiplier. Internally it runs quick Monte Carlo using sampled econ_records. It returns projected token burn and cache hit uplift
maria: We should be careful about presenting simulated savings as guarantees. Add a confidence band and a short tooltip explaining assumptions
kevin: Agreed — tooltip and a tiny annex under the panel with method: "sample-based MC, 95% CI, assumes steady-state traffic"
sam: For rollout UX: we'll want a canary that flips allocation algorithm for 1% of routes and shows delta in waterfall live. Can we do A/B at the routing layer?
kevin: Routing supports policy flags per-route. Canary API: `routing_policy_override(route, policy_json, pct)` — the dashboard can create the override and monitor econ delta in real time
liz: Add guardrails: auto-revert if cost overshoot > X% or latency regression > Y ms. Ops should be able to set thresholds
kevin: Good call. Implemented a policy watcher that reverts overrides based on perf/cost alarms
maria: Last ask — exportable CSV with each waterfall row and the underlying sample keys so finance can reconcile. Also a small query for auditors listing model versions and quantization used per window
kevin: CSV export is in prototype. Auditor query uses `econ_record.v1` with `model_hash` and `quant_tag` fields. No PII
sam: Could you drop the branch link + screenshots in #eng-platform and tag us? we'll poke the data and sanity-check numbers tomorrow
kevin: Will do. tagging @maria @liz @sam. Pushing screenshots and how-to in the PR description :thumbsup:
liz: Thanks — excited to try the simulation knob on our tenant samples
maria: Thanks, team. Quick win if we get lineage and sample badge in the first pass :raised_hands:
kevin: noted. I'll iterate tomorrow and post updates
